description: This file defines a React functional component named App, which manages a theme state ('light' or 'dark') and provides a toggle button to switch themes. It includes UI elements such as a button for toggling themes, an image, some text, and a link to React documentation. It also applies the selected theme to the document's data-theme attribute.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function that toggles the theme state between 'light' and 'dark'.
